text:
Dilute hydrochloric acid is titrated into a conical flask containing sodium hydroxide solution and a
few drops of methyl orange indicator.
Which piece of apparatus is used to add the hydrochloric acid?
A
beaker
B
burette
C
measuring cylinder
D
pipette
